text:
alex: quick follow-up to the postmortem 1: storage-cleanup caused a page flood last night. need small set of owners + dates to reduce noise.

maria: saw ~100 pages in 9m, ~75% duplicates. root causes: low threshold, no upstream dedupe, job retry burst.

kevin: suggested actions (i can take 1):
1) bump storage-cleanup alert threshold 3->12 failures/10m. owner: kevin. due: 2025-01-13.
2) add Alertmanager grouping: group_by ['alertname','job'], group_interval 5m. owner: alex. due: 2025-01-11.
3) ingestion dedupe: collapse identical alerts within 2m and include count. owner: maria. due: 2025-01-12.
4) scheduled-job silence: auto-silence around cron window +/-2m. owner: sara. due: 2025-01-10.

sara: I'll add the silence automation. confirm cron is `0 03 * * *` (UTC).

maria: yes that's the cron. i'll add retry backoff in the job PR to avoid cascades.

ops-bot: created ticket SINF-412 - "storage-cleanup paging noise" -> https://boards.redwood.internal/SINF-412

kevin: i'll open the threshold PR and include a small check to show pages drop.

alex: decision: collapse duplicates but show count in message. scheduling 15m sync Wed 10:00am PST to review PRs. move tickets to in-progress after PRs land.

maria: i'll add a dashboard panel for duplicate-rate to monitor impact.

sara: timelines ok for me.

alex: thanks all, closing this thread for action tracking.
